artifact: GST HYP-01 Analysis Lock — dated statistical-method amendment

authorization.commit_timestamp_is_authoritative_for_en: The git commit and push timestamps of this file record when the amendment entered version control. They are preserved by git and are deliberately not restated here.
authorization.declared_date_is_not_a_local_civil_date: The declared date is a UTC calendar date supplied by the authorizer. This artifact does not assert that the authorization occurred on 2026-08-16 in America/Chicago or in any other local timezone.
authorization.statement_verbatim: I authorize the recommended D1–D16 methodological package as specified on August 16, 2026.

D1.note: The study-written Python CR2 is a validated cross-check. The official confirmatory number is produced by the pinned R reference path.
D1.title: Primary covariance estimator

D10.future_threshold_rule: Any future cluster-count or effective-df threshold requires a NEW dated amendment authored without outcome inspection.
D10.title: Cluster-count and effective-df policy

official_confirmatory_calculation.environment: the exact locked package environment from PR #18

D12.applies_to: the locked secondary adjusted model ONLY
D12.existing_lock_override: If an existing lock already specifies a different reference rule, that rule governs; this amendment does not silently override it.
D12.reference_selection_rule: lexicographically first among represented non-OTHER sectors
D12.title: Sector fixed-effect encoding

D13.rank_deficient_fallback: If the pooled secondary design remains rank deficient, REFUSE the secondary model and report why. Do not alter the pooling threshold.
D13.threshold_note: The threshold of 3 is an authorizer-selected governance rule. PR #18 established nothing about sector pooling and provides no support for this or any other threshold.
D13.title: Sparse sectors

D16.future_power_analysis_rule: Any future power analysis must be anchored to citable EXTERNAL effect sizes and requires a NEW dated amendment authored before outcome inspection.
D16.title: Design-sensitivity policy

D2.note: Exactly one correction. CR1 scaling must not be applied on top of CR2.
D2.title: Finite-sample correction

D3.provenance_qualification: Implementation agreement for the continuous Satterthwaite df was established under a tolerance prespecified in PR #18. That tolerance was NOT preregistered in PR #17, whose df rule is exact integer equality for CR1's integer G-1.
D3.title: Degrees-of-freedom rule

D4.note: The wild cluster bootstrap-t plays no role in HYP-01.
D4.title: Wild bootstrap role

always_report: identities of singleton cluster labels only where the blinded analysis protocol permits
D8.title: Singleton clusters

D9.min_clusters_note: min_clusters_for_any_output is an ARITHMETIC floor inherited verbatim from the runner. It is not an eligibility rule and not a minimum-cluster policy; see D10, which imposes no cluster cutoff.

outcome_taxonomy.ANALYSIS_REFUSAL: a guard fired; no confirmatory p-value is produced
outcome_taxonomy.DATA_QUALITY_FAILURE: inputs failed capture or completeness rules
outcome_taxonomy.NULL_RESULT: the analysis ran and did not reject the null

thresholds_source.rationale: These thresholds were prespecified in the PR #17 feasibility runner before the corrected rerun and are adopted verbatim. No new numerical threshold is introduced by this amendment.

thresholds_verbatim.nonfinite_any: any non-finite value in the design matrix or outcome

D9.title: Invalid or degenerate fits
trigger_conditions: condition number exceeding the prespecified guard
residual variance below the prespecified relative noise-floor guard
nonpositive or non-finite Satterthwaite degrees of freedom
reference-package warning or error classified as fatal by this rule

decisions.bootstrap_reactivation_rule: No bootstrap setting is retained in an activatable state. Introducing any bootstrap role into HYP-01 requires a NEW dated amendment.

effective_lock_resolution.precedence: base lock v1.0 < dated amendment (this file)
procedure: 1. Load GST_HYP01_ANALYSIS_LOCK_v1.0.json as the base lock.
2. Verify every artifact hash recorded under evidence_referenced.
4. Fail closed if more than one amendment claims authority over the same field.
5. Apply this amendment's `decisions` as an overlay onto the base lock.
6. Every base-lock field not listed in amends.fields_amended remains operative verbatim.
7. Emit the effective-lock report; refuse to emit if any check fails.

epistemic_status.external_preregistration_note: Completing this internal lock does NOT make the study externally preregistered. External preregistration requires actual submission to an external timestamped registry, which has not occurred.
epistemic_status.implementation_validation_is_not_scienti: PR #18 established that the study's CR2/Satterthwaite code computes what clubSandwich computes on a synthetic fixture matrix. That is implementation agreement. It is not evidence that CR2 is the scientifically correct or optimal estimator for HYP-01, and it is not a result about the world.
epistemic_status.outcome_inspection_statement: At the moment this package was authorized, zero HYP-01-eligible prospective observations existed: results are null, frozen_event_ids is empty and eligible_events_now is 0. No effect estimate, direction, p-value, interim result or plot existed to inspect, and none was inspected.

split_tolerance_provenance.continuous_satterthwaite_df: validated under a separately prespecified PR #18 tolerance that was NOT preregistered in PR #17
split_tolerance_provenance.covariance_se_t_p: validated under the PR #17 preregistered tolerances

collection_unblock_conditions: F5 construct validity resolved and recorded
every other pre-observation gate in the cohort protocol and eligibility rules satisfied

proposed_v1_1_status_note: GST_HYP01_ANALYSIS_LOCK_v1.1_PROPOSED.json remains a PROPOSAL and is NOT authoritative. It is referenced here only as an input the authorizer considered. This dated amendment — not that file — is the authoritative statistical-rule overlay once merged.
supersedes_nothing_by_deletion: This amendment adds an overlay. It does not rewrite, delete, rename or activate any prior artifact. v1.0 remains the base lock and every rule it states that is not listed under `amends` remains operative verbatim.
